name: LocalHostLifecycle

instance_paths.input: launcher supplies one canonical instance root; default Windows root is resolved by LLD-12 packaging, not environment-variable guessing inside domain code
instance_paths.rule: canonicalized database and lock remain inside the resolved instance root; unexpected final reparse/symlink redirection is rejected

data_instance_lock.mechanism: hold an OS-level exclusive lock on the first byte of soma.instance.lock for the full authoritative host lifetime using the supported Windows file-lock implementation
data_instance_lock.authority: file existence/content alone proves nothing; only the held OS lock establishes path ownership
data_instance_lock.contended: do not migrate/start a second host; hand control to LLD-12 verified-existing-instance flow or exit INSTANCE_OWNED
data_instance_lock.crash: OS releases the lock automatically; stale lock file may remain and is non-authoritative

loopback_socket.windows_option: set SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE before bind; do not enable SO_REUSEADDR
sequence: retain ownership and pass already-bound socket to uvicorn.Server.serve(sockets=[socket])
loopback_socket.reason: OS chooses the free port while SOMA already owns the socket, eliminating free-port probe/bind races

uvicorn_config.ws: disabled unless LLD-10 later proves a required websocket use case

runtime_registry.publication: serialize deterministic UTF-8 JSON to same-directory temporary file, flush, fsync file where supported, os.replace to runtime.json; only publish after server is listening and security context is ready
runtime_registry.removal: remove only after proving registry run_id + data_instance_id belong to the shutting-down host; stale foreign registry is never blindly deleted

request_execution.event_loop: ASGI parsing/routing/response and lightweight guards only
request_execution.application_calls: dispatch blocking application-service/repository work to host-owned request executor (max 4 workers)
request_execution.background_calls: durable coordinator dispatches file/CPU/blocking jobs to separate executor (max 2 workers)
request_execution.sqlite: each executor invocation obtains/closes its own thread-confined connection; no connection is captured by ASGI task state

readiness: only READY accepts ordinary application queries/mutations; migration/status control paths have their separately governed availability
